items.title: 2.3 Experimental evidence for the electronic configuration

source_refs.note: Topic 2.3, printed page 25: the two sources of evidence introduced; the detail follows in 2.4.1 and 2.3.2 as printed.

blocks.text: The modern theory of electronic structure originates from the Bohr Model of atom. Evidence for this and later models of the atoms derives principally from two sources; atomic spectra and ionization energies.
